name: Belmonte Tirol
beschreibung: The Belmonte Tirol is a hotel in the municipality of Sillian in the district of Lienz. It is located in the upper Pustertal near the border with Südtirol. The accommodation offers comfortably furnished rooms and suites. Guests have access to a wellness area with sauna and steam bath. The location is a starting point for activities in the Naturpark Rieserferner-Ahrn. In winter, the nearby ski areas of Sillianer Bergbahnen can be used. The hotel restaurant serves regional dishes from Tiroler and Italian cuisine.
